title: Smelter & mineral refining operator dossier registry · sourced historical cohort and ongoing 2026 case tracking
methodology: Track a unique facility/project entity rather than conflating a park's tenants with an industrial park owner. Enriched entries overlay the existing named ESDM registry by original_id; other ESDM entries are retained with unknown capacity/ownership and explicit 2026 status not verified. WGS84 pins are locality references only; facility-site surveyed coordinates have not been established. Nameplate/design capacity, actual annual production, ore throughput, and announced future capacities are different denominators and must never be summed. ESDM integrated regulated 2025 smelter cohort (28, 13 operating and 15 process/planned) differs from the Marves nickel project inventory of 147 units recorded in 2024 and cited by IPB in 2025. Neither is a verified nationwide 2026 operating count. Historical reports may differ in included company, regulator jurisdiction and project definition.

official_baseline.scope: ESDM Ditjen Minerba monitored integrated smelters as of 31 Dec 2025; includes nickel, tin, copper, gold, bauxite and iron, with differing facility boundary versus 2024. Not the nationwide number of every operating industrial smelter.
official_baseline.comparison_warning: 2024 and 2025 ESDM datasets use different administrative inclusion and facility classifications; the difference is NOT a verified number of new completions.

academic_nickel_baseline.title: Nickel-processing inventory by production method and lifecycle (historical)
academic_nickel_baseline.methodology: Aggregate list attributed to Kemenko Marves (Adi, 3 Nov 2024), reproduced in IPB University peer-reviewed article 2025. Includes operating and announced construction/planned units; covers nickel only, across integrated and stand-alone arrangements. Not a census of 2026 plants, nor 147 operating plants. Unit/plant definitions and individual-site identities cannot be fully inferred from aggregated figures.
academic_nickel_baseline.original_citation: Kemenko Marves / Adi (3 November 2024) quoted by Octaviana Randrikasari et al., Jurnal Pengelolaan Lingkungan Pertambangan, Vol 2 No 1, 2025

historical_conflict.note: Bappenas Q3 2023 diagram cites 49 operating/34 construction/36 planned pyrometallurgical units (119), plus 27 hydro units, a different earlier snapshot. Do not treat 2023 and 2024 counts as identical.

count_definitions.planning: Projects planned in 2024; not completed plants

official_2024.reporting_program: ESDM Ditjen Minerba integrated-smelter programme under regulatory oversight
official_2024.note: Programme perimeter distinct from 2025 integrated programme and broader 147-unit nickel industry inventory. 6 existing, 9 on progress; does not include all stand-alone Kemenperin facilities.

source_notes.statement: 2024: 15 integrated-smelter programme records (6 existing, 9 in progress); includes 4 operating nickel, two copper, six bauxite planned, two nickel planned and one iron planned.
End-2025: 28 integrated-smelter cases, 13 operating and 15 process/planned; 4 operating nickel and 6 operating tin, not national nickel census.
Marves / Adi November 2024 nickel all-status inventory 147 projects/units: pyro 120 and hydro 27. Published 2025 by IPB. NOT 2026 operational.
